title: oxytropis deflexa subsp. retrorsa
intro: Oxytropis deflexa subsp. retrorsa, commonly known as the Tibetan milkvetch, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is a type of legume native to the high-altitude regions of the Tibetan Plateau, known for its unique ability to survive in extreme conditions. The health benefits of Oxytropis deflexa subsp. retrorsa include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may help in reducing the risk of various diseases such as cardiovascular disorders and cancer. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may exhibit anti-cancer, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
